question.text: The overarching principle of good practices is:

answer.text: Treating investor interest as paramount and maintaining high standards of ethics, integrity, fairness, due diligence and proper care while avoiding conflicts and unfair or fraudulent practices

explanation.text: The Logic: The XIX-A workbook frames good practices around investor best interest as paramount, high standards of ethics, integrity and fairness, high service standards, due diligence, proper care, and avoiding conflicts of interest and unfair or fraudulent practices. The Trap: Maximizing sales at any cost, avoiding regulation, or competing without ethics all contradict the workbook's core principles. Note: "Market integrity" wording was not located in the pages checked; the supported wording focuses on investor interest, ethics, fairness, due diligence and avoiding conflicts/fraudulent practices.
